packages.proof_question: The integrated system materially constrains populations or institutions while private actors retain disproportionate authority or residual value.
required_records: ordinary, unsuccessful, contradictory, and absent controls
packages.falsifier: Use is voluntary or contestable, alternatives remain practical, consequences are independently governed, and public recovery and exit rights work.
